description: Memory records changed since a cursor, for bobbin's memory mirror: current ones to upsert, superseded ones to delete. cursor = '<instant>|<iri>' (a current row's recordedAt; a superseded row's supersededAt, else the replacing record's recordedAt), ordered by recordedAt then iri; pass the last row's cursor back as since. 50 rows plus one overflow sentinel. Generated by scripts/memory_tools.py.
name: mem_index_since

params.description: The cursor of the last row of the previous page, '<recordedAt>|<iri>'; empty for a full pull.
params.name: since

params.description: The crew:declared plane graph IRI; pass it when CAMAYOC_PLANE_NS is not the default.
params.name: declared

params.description: The crew:records plane graph IRI; pass it when CAMAYOC_PLANE_NS is not the default.
params.name: records

params.description: The crew:inferred plane graph IRI; pass it when CAMAYOC_PLANE_NS is not the default.
params.name: inferred

template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?iri ?naturalKey ?kind ?label (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT STR(?b); separator=" | ") AS ?body) ?sourceKind ?recordedAt ?reviewAfter ?expiresAt ?status ?cursor FROM <{declared}> FROM <{records}> FROM <{inferred}> WHERE { ?iri aegis:naturalKey ?naturalKey ; a ?kind ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:recordedAt ?recordedAt . OPTIONAL { VALUES ?bp { aegis:chose aegis:locator aegis:next aegis:prefers aegis:rule } ?iri ?bp ?b } OPTIONAL { ?iri aegis:sourceKind ?sourceKind } OPTIONAL { ?iri aegis:reviewAfter ?reviewAfter } OPTIONAL { ?iri aegis:expiresAt ?expiresAt } { ?iri aegis:recordedAt ?currentAt . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?iri aegis:supersededBy ?anyNewer } BIND("current" AS ?status) BIND(CONCAT(STR(?currentAt), "|", STR(?iri)) AS ?cursor) } UNION { ?iri aegis:supersededBy ?newer ; aegis:supersededAt ?supersededAt . BIND("superseded" AS ?status) BIND(CONCAT(STR(?supersededAt), "|", STR(?iri)) AS ?cursor) } UNION { ?iri aegis:supersededBy ?newer . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?iri aegis:supersededAt ?stamped } ?newer aegis:recordedAt ?replacedAt . BIND("superseded" AS ?status) BIND(CONCAT(STR(?replacedAt), "|", STR(?iri)) AS ?cursor) } FILTER(?cursor > '{since}') } GROUP BY ?iri ?naturalKey ?kind ?label ?sourceKind ?recordedAt ?reviewAfter ?expiresAt ?status ?cursor ORDER BY ?cursor LIMIT 51
